requirement: v3.3.16 integrates Relay v3.0.0 three-node cluster sync with the plugin P0 stateDir fix, one online predicate and visible version drift; never-ask keeps the red approval channel

assertions.relay_cluster: all three relays report relay_version 3.0.0, features contain relay-cluster-sync-v1 and cluster.last_ok is true
assertions.state_dir: configuredStateDir falls back to $DSH_HOME/xclient when the profile omits stateDir, so memory/RTT/P2P survive on every machine
assertions.online_predicate: w2m_devices and the target control both use isSelectableDevice; a device with online:false is no longer reported as online
assertions.version_drift: w2m_devices version_drift lists current/versions/behind; older 2.0.x and 2.2.x machines are visible as behind
assertions.dispatch_states: docs/DISPATCH-TRI-STATE-20261115.md records real ok, failed, divergent and partial tasks, all write:false
assertions.approval_policy: never-ask + joint-dev stays blocked with the red channel retained; no pre-signed approval and no dispatch closure
